summary: Full-stack regression for cloud-migrated Tasklio. BACKEND: 26/26 pytest cases PASS against public preview URL (/app/backend/tests/test_tasklio_cloud.py). Verified auth (register/login/duplicate 409/wrong pw 401/invalid mobile 422), user flow (earn+txn, checkin first ok / second 400, chances consume+add, payout deduct + pending, invalid UPI 400, insufficient points 400, /me returns full state, /config public), admin token via ADMIN_ACCESS_KEY (wrong key 403), admin guards (no token 401 / user token 403 on /admin/dashboard and /admin/users), admin actions (dashboard counts, users list contains new user, payouts list, PATCH points adjusts and increments user balance, approve payout marks successful, reject payout refunds points to user and marks failed, broadcast notify returns ok+recipients and shows up in user notif feed, PUT /admin/config saves + returns updated checkinRewards). Admin push upstream returns non-200 due to placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY — swallowed by try/except as expected, non-blocking. FRONTEND: Expo web preview loads at /home, splash tagline 'Play. Earn. Cash out.' present, auth-modal renders with all expected testIDs, Create Account registers via backend and dismisses modal, home screen shows the user's name (UI Test User) and real state (points, daily check-in, missions). Drawer opens via home-menu-button, double-tap on drawer-restricted-area opens access-key modal, entering 9372@Altaf93Tasklio in access-key-input + access-key-submit routes to /admin. Admin Panel Dashboard shows REAL counts driven by MongoDB (3 users / 2 pending ₹11 / 1 paid ₹5) — confirming end-to-end admin wiring. Manage tabs (Banner/Notification) render config-backed content. Only console noise: expo-notifications web push listener warning (harmless, web-only). No red screens, no crash, no missing testIDs, no deprecated Expo packages detected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 686 lines — approaching but under 700. Consider splitting admin routes into a submodule if it grows further.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in Starlette/FastAPI; migrate to lifespan context manager (non-blocking, harmless today).

admin_notify: on push failure sent count reports 0 even though recipients count is non-zero (correct semantics: 'pushed' = 0 when upstream fails). Frontend admin UI should read 'recipients' not 'pushed' for confirmation copy.

PATCH /admin/users/{id}/points can drive balance negative before the corrective clamp (find_one_and_update then set to 0). Race-safe alternative: single aggregation update with $max. Cosmetic — no impact observed.
No deprecated Expo packages present (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed users, transactions, payouts, and one broadcast notification 'TEST broadcast' in tasklio_database during pytest run. Non-destructive; config is reverted at end of the config test.
